rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root, not a candidate: the classical D^2-law with the published median rate, replaced by the prefix's own finite-difference rate as the prefix grows; no extinction and no evaporation. Same numbers as the baseline of flex_methanol-wsp-v2, with the tensors added by flex_methanol-wsp-v3 set to their neutral values. Data-informed candidates of flex_methanol-wsp-v3 are literal revisions of this release, so that the registry records them as revisions with development exposure rather than as one-shot releases.
